svg.title: CHRONA Batch 7 — Onboarding, Permissions, Screensaver & System States Contact Sheet
svg.desc: Complete 5x3 visual overview of all 15 Batch 7 artboards on 412x915dp AMOLED canvases.
svg.text: CHRONA Batch 7 — Onboarding, Permissions, Screensaver & System States
15 Artboards · 412 × 915dp AMOLED Grid · Completing the CHRONA Visual Design Suite

g.title: CHRONA — Welcome Onboarding
g.desc: Minimal clock artwork, Chrona brand identity, short description, and Continue CTA.

g.title: CHRONA Onboarding — Smarter Alarms
g.desc: Feature introduction screen 1 highlighting gradual volume and exact alarm reliability.

g.text: Gradual audio ramps, flexible repeat rules,
and exact scheduling that survives reboots.

g.title: CHRONA Onboarding — World Clock
g.desc: Feature introduction screen 2 showcasing the slate world map and color-linked city cards.

g.text: Persistent pastel identity strips link each
city card directly to its glowing map pin.

g.title: CHRONA Onboarding — Cross-Timezone Intelligence
g.desc: Feature introduction screen 3 demonstrating destination alarm time converted to local phone ring time.

g.text: Set alarms in a destination timezone and
always see the exact local time your phone rings.

g.title: CHRONA — Notification Permission Education
g.desc: Android notification permission explanation for alarms, snooze actions, and live timer alerts.

g.text: ringing alarms, timers, and bedtime alerts
can appear on your lock screen.
Dismiss or snooze directly from alerts
Track active timers while using other apps

g.title: CHRONA — Exact Alarm Access & Recovery
g.desc: Native Android exact-alarm permission education with current status, system settings action, and recovery steps.

g.text: Chrona needs Android's exact-alarm permission so
local and cross-timezone alarms fire at the exact
scheduled second, even during deep device sleep.
RECOVERY STATE · IF DENIED OR REVOKED
3. Turn on "Allow setting alarms and reminders"

g.title: CHRONA — Full-Screen Alarm Permission
g.desc: Full-screen alarm display education with Continue, Later, and permission unavailable fallback behavior.

g.text: Allows Chrona to display the immersive AMOLED
ringing screen over your lock screen so Snooze
and Dismiss controls are immediately reachable.
If full-screen intents are turned off in Android
settings, alarms will ring as a high-priority
heads-up notification banner instead of taking

g.title: CHRONA Screensaver — Minimal Digital Clock
g.desc: Pure pitch-black AMOLED nightstand digital clock with subtle date and next alarm whisper.

g.title: CHRONA Screensaver — Typography Clock
g.desc: Oversized stacked typographic clock composition on pure pitch-black AMOLED.

g.title: CHRONA Screensaver — Ambient World Clock
g.desc: Ambient AMOLED world map screensaver with glowing city markers, primary local clock, and selected city readout.

g.title: CHRONA System States — Loading & Success
g.desc: Weather skeleton loading state and successful alarm creation feedback.

g.text: Your phone will ring at 13:45 local time

g.title: CHRONA System States — Offline & Missing Weather
g.desc: Offline status notice and missing weather data fallback while preserving exact clock functionality.

g.text: All world clocks & alarms continue accurately.
Live weather updates will resume online.
Weather data unavailable for this location

g.title: CHRONA System States — Empty States
g.desc: No saved cities, search without results, and generic empty list states.

g.text: Add cities to compare local times across the globe.
Check spelling or search by country / IANA zone.
Items you create will appear in this list.

g.title: CHRONA System States — General Error
g.desc: Calm, actionable general error card with Try again recovery CTA.

g.text: Something went wrong while syncing updates.
Your saved clocks and active alarms remain

g.title: CHRONA System States — Permissions Unavailable
g.desc: Alarm permission unavailable and notifications disabled system states with legitimate Android Settings links.

g.text: Scheduled alarms may ring late until exact-alarm
permission is enabled in Android system settings.
and lock-screen alarm banners will not appear.
